full_judgment: 3. Plaintiff respondent Abdul Hamid and others filed a Partition Suit being T.S. No. 31 of 1960 in the 4th Court of Subordinate Judge, Dhaka for partition in respect of the land appertaining to CS Khatian No. 11 of Mouja Pakiabad PS Kapasia District Dhaka. In addition to the usual share inherited by plaintiff respondent 3.07 acres of land was claimed by way of partition on the basis of purchase as per registered kabala marked Ext. 1-C.
